modelOverview: The Royal Oak Frosted Gold 41mm brings together two of Audemars Piguet's signature crafts: the Florentine hammering technique that gives the gold its shimmering, diamond-dust 'Frosted' finish, and the openworked Double Balance Wheel movement visible through a skeletonised dial. Launched in 2021 as a boutique-only 'Rainbow' series, the reference 15412 was offered in pink, white and yellow Frosted gold, each set with a bezel of multicoloured baguette-cut gemstones. It is among the most exclusive full-size Royal Oaks, pairing artisanal case work with high jewellery gem-setting.
